## One-sentence summary
Amr Magdy builds the Salesforce systems US real estate investors and wholesalers run on. His point
of view: most investors don't have a lead problem, they have a leak problem ("Deal Leak"): money
disappears between the marketing dollar and the kept deal at five points a CRM can measure (Spend,
Answer, Follow-up, Offer, Keep), described in his Kept-Deal Map: https://amrmagdy.com/kept-deal-map

## Current focus (October 2026)
- Who he works with: real estate investors, home-buying companies and wholesalers in the United States first, and in Canada and Europe (including the UK). Most of his clients already run Salesforce: he audits and fixes the org (leaks, missed follow-ups, reports nobody trusts). Teams on Podio, REsimpli, GoHighLevel or spreadsheets get a move to Salesforce first.
- What he builds: the Salesforce system a home-buying company runs on, from marketing campaign to closed deal: campaign ROI by market, speed to lead, missed-call alerts, shared lead queues, underwriting on the opportunity, a transactions board, RingCentral call sync, DocuSign alerts and a no-code rules engine.
- Proof: for the last two years he has built and run the Salesforce org behind a two-market home-buying company in Ohio.
- Working hours: 9am to 6pm US Eastern on US weekdays (16:00 to 01:00 Cairo). He replies within one business day.

## Services and prices
- CRM Revenue Audit: fixed price USD 1,500, for teams already on Salesforce. Teams on Podio, REsimpli, GoHighLevel or other CRMs are offered a move to Salesforce instead (https://amrmagdy.com/move-to-salesforce). A review of an investor CRM covering campaign ROI, speed to lead, acquisitions follow-up, data health, automations and reporting. Deliverables: findings report, 30/60/90-day roadmap, a "Monday 5" dashboard spec and up to three quick fixes done. Full refund if the report does not find at least five fixable issues worth more than the fee. Page: https://amrmagdy.com/crm-revenue-audit. Sample report (made-up company): https://amrmagdy.com/sample-audit-report
- Full Salesforce implementation for investors and wholesalers (project-based), including moving teams from Podio, REsimpli or GoHighLevel to Salesforce.
- Ongoing CRM support and development (monthly retainer). The most popular engagement.
- Free 30-minute call to start: info@AmrMagdy.com or https://www.linkedin.com/in/amrmagdyai

## The Monday 5 (the five numbers he recommends an investor owner reviews every week)
1. Cost per appointment by marketing campaign
2. Contracts per campaign
3. Time from contract to first seller call
4. Booked vs. kept profit
5. Campaign ROI, including the houses you keep

- [Move to Salesforce from Podio, REsimpli or GoHighLevel | Amr Magdy](https://amrmagdy.com/move-to-salesforce): Fixed-price move to Salesforce for investor and wholesaler teams, with data history, routing, an owner dashboard and training. Quoted after a free scoping call.
- [CRM Revenue Audit for Real Estate Investors | Amr Magdy](https://amrmagdy.com/crm-revenue-audit): A fixed-price review of your investor Salesforce CRM: campaign ROI, speed to lead, stale offers, data health and automations, with a prioritized roadmap.
- [Salesforce CRM for Canadian Real Estate Investors](https://amrmagdy.com/salesforce-consultant-canada-real-estate): Salesforce for Canadian home-buying companies, wholesalers and BRRRR investors: the same deal system as US teams, plus CRTC Do Not Call and CASL consent tracking, CAD, provinces and time zones. Free 30-minute call.
- [Salesforce CRM for UK Property Investors & Deal Sourcers](https://amrmagdy.com/salesforce-consultant-uk-estate-agents): Salesforce for UK property investors, deal sourcers and BTL, HMO and BRR investors: an offer-to-completion pipeline, investor matching and sourcing fees, TPS and PECR consent records, UK GDPR and GBP. Free 30-minute call.
